evidence.decision: Chooses a value-selection mechanism from list scale and semantic type, then resolves stored date/duration meaning independently from display order.
evidence.artifact: Requires value/display/commit implementation or a concrete option/date specification with ordering, bounds and stored semantics.
evidence.transformation: Scheduling example replaces hardcoded month/day order,7-minute intervals and unsupported compact countdown with localized order and supported choices.
evidence.verification: Checks locale/calendar changes, boundaries, permitted keyboard entry and cancellation; fails altered date meaning or unreachable valid choices.
evidence.applicability: Preserves divisor-of60 interval rule, countdown style restrictions, Mac precision/calendar choices and watch Crown-friendly options.
evidence.handoffs: Loads pop-up-buttons for compact single selection or lists-and-tables when very large datasets need different access.
evidence.distinctiveness: Mode/style compatibility, localized ordering and instant/date/duration distinctions produce actual picker decisions.
